notes.title: EASY MODE / ARCADE MODE!!!!
notes.content: [p]If there's one slither of feedback I'll allow (and I am very fragile), it's that Game Over - A Musical RPG?? might cater too heavily to the Rhythm Gamer crowd.  [b] WELL NO LONGER.[/b][/p][p]Introducing [i]Least Hard mode,[/i] available in all good options menus, and selectable at all stages of gameplay! Least Hard mode is targeted at those not willing to spend hours grinding at boss battles, but don't want the tedium of watching notes fly by on Nigel Mode. Least Hard only uses 4 keys (by default FGHJ), and further reduces the amount of notes comin' at ya. The difficulty curve is significantly smoothed out, asking less blood from the players.[/p][p][/p][p]Now.[/p][p][/p][p]If there's another slither of feedback I'll allow (and don't forget, I'm [i]very [/i]fragile), it's that Game Over - A Musical RPG?? might not cater heavily enough to the Rhythm Gamer crowd. [b] WELL NO LONGER.[/b][/p][p]Introducing [i]Arcade Mode, [/i]available in all good profile selection menus! Arcade Mode allows you to replay any previously found duets, with a variety of devious modifiers: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Squiggly! Writhe in pain as all notes wriggle their way down the note track, hope you ain't colourblind![/p][/*][*][p]Remixed! Randomize all notes to keep you guessing?? Don't ask me, I'm just a developer![/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight! Night time has struck the arcade mode, but a trusty flashlight promises to illuminate your way - here's hoping that klutz holds it straight![/p][/*][*][p]Fade In/Out/BOTH: Bashful notes in the middle of getting changed certainly don't want to be looked at the WHOLE time they're coming down the board...[/p][/*][*][p]More to come![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What's next for Game Over - A Musical RPG??[/b][/p][p]I think a Leaderboard wouldn't go awry, would you? And mayhaps a few more modifiers, mayhaps?[/p]

notes.title: Restoring latest patch
notes.content:
Had issue with previous patch causing the very first battle to break (G+ H would loop the charge up sound and not progress to battle). I previously restored the old safe version, but now returning the to the new version.

This patch adds script execution ordering for scripts associated with the battle manager, hopefully fixing the ghost notes glitch.
Also makes some routing in Route_11 a little easier!

notes.title: Reverting patch, critical error in first duet with Brusko
notes.content: Reverting due to bug on playing first battle, will sort out Script Execution, then patch.

notes.title: QUITE GOOD: A GAME OVER Extravaganza - Feat., Me, REMIX (Gone Steamsual)
notes.content:
hi

I'm Jake, I've been making this game by myself for 6 years. I give full consent to be mean about it (it's good for morale). 

Game Over is a bit like Doki Doki Literature Club in that they both run on Windows PC's, but are otherwise quite dissimilar. I suppose it's more like Stanley Parable in that it has achievements, but is otherwise a very different game. If anything, it's like Pony Island, in that Game Over has an Island.

Sorry all of this is actually in the resume I attached and I'm not sure why I need to double up and add this here??
